name: Zenergy Solar & Roofing
old_description: Zenergy Solar has helped homeowners across Delaware, Southern New Jersey, and Eastern Pennsylvania go solar since 2005. With roughly two decades in business, thousands of satisfied customers, and BBB accreditation, we design and install residential solar and home battery systems that lower electric bills and add lasting value to your home.
about:
Zenergy Solar & Roofing operates from Wilmington, Delaware, where it was founded in 2005 as a small company focused on helping homeowners reduce energy costs. The business has grown over roughly two decades into a full-service home upgrade contractor serving the Mid-Atlantic region.

The company designs and installs residential solar arrays, battery storage systems, EV chargers, roofing, HVAC and heat-pump equipment, insulation, and smart-home controls. Each project begins with a free home energy audit that uses thermal imaging, blower-door testing, drone roof scans, and water testing to produce a custom scope of work. In-house crews carry out all installations, and the firm coordinates permitting, inspections, and utility interconnection.

Zenergy serves homeowners throughout Delaware (Wilmington, Newark, Dover), southern New Jersey (Cherry Hill, Marlton, Mount Laurel, Willingboro, Brick), and eastern Pennsylvania (Philadelphia suburbs and the PECO territory). Its customer base is exclusively residential, and the company highlights thousands of completed projects across the three-state area.

Leadership says the business was started out of an obsession with saving homeowners money and a commitment to finishing every job to a single standard. The firm emphasizes one coordinated team, premium materials such as GAF shingles and tier-1 solar panels from Tesla, Generac, Q CELLS, and Silfab, on-time completion, and 24/7 system monitoring backed by workmanship and product warranties.
